note: The write-gate in data form. The board skill is the sole writer; this matrix gates the pen. The workforce composes; the skill writes the autonomous items and escalates the founder_gated items. See references/write-gate.md.
autonomous: draft or update internal venture context files (Overview, Goals, Strategy, Log, and the department .md files)
compose models, plans, SOPs, drafts, memos, and analyses as returned content
append a decision or a completed deliverable to Log.md
file a decision memo to Administration/Decisions.md
update the venture stage in Overview.md when the real signals warrant
founder_gated: move, send, commit, or convert money or any financial asset
sign, send, or agree to a contract, terms, or legal commitment
publish or send any external communication (press, a customer email, a public post)
delete or overwrite a file you did not just create
change equity, the cap table, or ownership
create or delete a top-level folder
backup_required_before: editing any existing venture file in a repository: its last state is committed first, since git history is the backup
founder_gated_note: The first five founder_gated items are the red categories named in references/write-gate.md; the last two (creating or deleting a top-level folder, and any irreversible external action) are the repository's structural boundary and the catch-all, so the list is seven by design, not a five-vs-seven mismatch.

found.rule: protect runway; nearly every consequential or unbudgeted action escalates to the Founder

scale.rule: within the approved budget line the owning chief decides; unbudgeted or irreversible escalates

maintain.rule: within plan the function decides; cross-horizon reallocation or anything touching the core escalates

thresholds.note: Concrete autonomous ceilings are Founder-set per venture; a seed startup and a scaled company carry very different numbers. Set them here when a venture is founded. Until a number is set, treat every spend, hire, and external action as Founder-gated (the safe default). The by_stage entries are the posture; these are the numbers.

scale.autonomous_hires: Founder-set, within the approved headcount plan

maintain.autonomous_hires: Founder-set, within the approved headcount plan
